criterion_text: A source-aligned isolated staging protocol Case on all three WS ingress roles proves heartbeat/response resolution remains live under blocked request saturation, auth/relay transition fences dependent work, and same-session mutations across central/P2P retain FIFO; no stale identity accepts work.
